uncertainty: Sixteen distinct Maven artifacts passed valid H.264/AAC MP4 controls. The previous fourteen paths are joined by JAAD and Tianscar Java Sound AAC. JAAD and Java Sound AAC share the JAAD pure Java MP4 demultiplexer family, with Tianscar a fork. Other shared families remain: MP4Parser isoparser/muxer, Tika over metadata-extractor, seven FFmpeg/FFprobe paths, and two libmediainfo paths. The original MP4 has optional user metadata that JAAD 0.8.7 cannot parse, so JAAD was verified on a second valid two-stream MP4 with that optional box removed; the generator, pinned bytes, SHA-256, top-level boxes, and FFprobe stream check document this control. The amilesend path uses a valid padded MP4 because its API requires at least 65536 bytes. Native classpaths and executables are SHA-256-locked where needed. Eight bounded Maven Solr queries used 100-result limits. Successful windows saved 128 hits, 122 unique; the broad mp4 query saved 100 of 350, mp4 parser saved six, isoparser saved four, and Java MP4 saved 18. ISO base media returned zero; JAAD MP4, JavaSound AAC MP4, and MP4 demuxer timed out. Earlier successful windows are preserved after refresh timeouts. Most Java MP4 hits use mp for unrelated software, and 18 remain unreviewed search hits. The MP4Parser aggregate POM, ytk-mp4j, CodecMedia 1.2.2, and jaudiotagger 3.0.1 were rejected for documented or observed lack of MP4 parsing on the control. MonteMedia documents MP4 write support only. Six targeted leads remain unresolved, including older and patched MP4Parser distributions, the streaming module, and Velvet Video. This is below the 20-path working goal and does not establish the most-used top 20. The controls prove box, track, handler, dimension, audio-rate, codec, and title parsing for these MP4 variants only. Java SE 25 official API documentation yielded no bundled MP4 parser; a JDK-only run found no ImageIO or Java Sound reader for the original control. Third-party providers may add support. No vulnerability, malformed-input or resource-use experiments were run.
